battle.name: 羅馬征服安格爾西
battle.brief: 公元60年，羅馬不列顛行省總督斯托尼奧·保利努斯以奇襲渡海攻取曼島（安格爾西）：艦隊在海峽正面佯動，步兵與巴達維、吞格利輔助軍藏身林中，涉水搶上灘頭，驅散聚在木樁柵後的守軍。卡面的羅馬弩砲是軍團野戰縱隊裡的直射火器，負責在渡口壓制與掩護登岸。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 安格爾西之役發生在公元60年，交戰的一方是羅馬帝國尼祿朝的不列顛駐軍，另一方是居於曼島（拉丁文作 Mona，威爾斯語 Ynys Môn，英語 Anglesey）的布立吞部族聯盟。羅馬方面由行省總督蓋烏斯·斯托尼奧·保利努斯統率，行省的常備軍是第二奧古斯都、第六凱旋、第十四孿生、第四十瓦勒里亞四個戰團，加上巴達維人、吞格利人等輔助軍團與騎兵隊；通往島嶼的海路由帝國海軍分遣隊維持，戰團旗艦與載兵船隻停泊在海峽一側。島上沒有留下文字記載的首領姓名，只能從地名推想其結構：島上以一個或多個部族聯盟的形式自治，關鍵的組織力量是德魯伊教的一支派系。公元43年克勞狄在布列塔尼亞清洗德魯伊時，逃到島上的祭司成為羅馬眼中的北線反對核心；島的孤立位置既使它成為宗教中心，也使它成了海上劫掠的根據地。羅馬在英格蘭大部的統治並非直轄，而是靠客戶王契約維持：公元43年，卡特維拉尼人的卡拉塔庫斯還曾派使團到羅馬求援，說明客戶王本身就是羅馬秩序的一部分；卡姆羅迪努姆的伊肯尼王國由普拉蘇塔格斯與其女王布狄卡掌握，北部布立根特人由迦提曼杜阿女王統治，東部與南部的其他王國也都保有不屬於羅馬的軍力。安格爾西之役正是在這樣的背景裡發生：帝國用一次成功的渡海突擊打掉了北線的抵抗中心，卻沒有在島上留下常駐編制。
countriesEn: The conquest of Anglesey was fought in AD 60. On one side stood the Roman imperial forces in Britain under the emperor Nero; on the other stood a Brythonic tribal confederation settled on the island of Mona (the Welsh Ynys Môn, English Anglesey). The Roman command was that of Gaius Suetonius Paulinus, governor of the province of Britannia. The permanent army of the province was made up of four legions — II Augusta, VI Victrix, XIV Gemina and XX Valeria Victrix — together with auxiliary cohorts such as the Batavians and the Tungrians and a body of cavalry; the sea lane to the island was kept open by a detachment of the imperial navy, and the legionary flagships and the troop transports lay moored on one side of the strait. No chief of the island is named in writing, and its structure can only be inferred from place names: the island governed itself as one or more tribal confederations, and the decisive organisational force within it was a branch of the Druidic order. When Claudius struck at the druids in Britain in AD 43, the priests who fled to the island became the core of the northern opposition as Rome saw it; the island's isolation made it at once a centre of religion and a base for seaborne raiding. Rome's rule over most of England was not direct administration but the maintenance of client kings by treaty. In AD 43 Caratacus of the Catuvellauni still sent an embassy to Rome seeking help, which shows that the client kings were themselves part of the Roman order; the Icenian kingdom of Camulodunum was held by Prasutagus and his queen Boudica, the Brigantes by the queen Cartimandua, and the other eastern and southern kingdoms kept military forces of their own. The Angles campaign took place against that background: the empire broke the centre of resistance on its northern line with a single successful assault from the sea, and left no permanent establishment on the island afterwards.
people: 留下姓名的關鍵人物只有三位。指揮這場攻擊的是蓋烏斯·斯托尼奧·保利努斯。他是西班牙出身的舊族，早在圖拉真與哈德良時代已在帝國邊境領兵，公元58年出任不列顛行省總督，到任後先平定威爾斯北部的山地，再把戰線推到梅奈海峽。留下這段文字的兩位作家是卡西烏斯·狄奧與塔西佗：狄奧在《羅馬史》第六十二卷記述渡海突擊的全程，塔西佗在《阿格里科拉傳》第二十四節記錄了十八年後同一套戰法的重演；《弗洛魯斯〈羅馬史綱〉》與《蘇埃托尼烏斯〈克勞狄傳〉》則各以一兩句提到島上德魯伊巢穴被清剿。德魯伊一方的首領姓名沒有流傳，古代作家只說他們聚居在島上、主持祭典，並在城破之後逃散；留下姓名的只是那位抵抗者「安格爾西人」群體的名號本身。真正決定這場戰役後續走向的人是卡姆羅迪努姆的伊肯尼女王布狄卡。公元60年，布狄卡的丈夫普拉蘇塔格斯去世，留下的遺囑把王國一半留給羅馬、一半給他的兩個女兒；羅馬的金融官卻在繼承人成年之前就沒收了全部土地與莊園，激起東部一列部族的一致反抗。就在同一個戰役季節，保利努斯在海峽對岸動手攻島，結果把帝國可用於東線的兵力調開，而東線隨即爆發全面起義。戰後保利努斯被召回羅馬，據塔西佗記載，他其後獲得了凱旋式的榮譽；東線的戰事則由他的繼任者彼得羅尼奧斯·圖爾皮利亞努斯在公元61至62年掃平，島嶼則要等公元78年才被阿格里科拉重新收復。
peopleEn: Only three names of consequence survive. The attack was commanded by Gaius Suetonius Paulinus. He came of an old Spanish family, had already led troops on the empire's frontiers in the reigns of Trajan and Hadrian, and was appointed governor of the province of Britannia in AD 58; once in post he first pacified the uplands of northern Wales and then pushed the line of operations out to the Menai Strait. Two writers preserve the story. Cassius Dio describes the whole crossing in the sixty-second book of his Roman History, and Tacitus records the repetition of the same trick eighteen years later in the twenty-fourth chapter of his Agricola; the Epitome of Florus and Suetonius' Life of Claudius add a sentence or two each on the destruction of the Druidic nest on the island. No name survives for any leader of the Druids: the ancient writers say only that they were gathered on the island, that they conducted their rites there, and that they scattered after the place was taken; what survives is only the collective name of the people who resisted, the Anglii of the island. The person who really decided the aftermath of the campaign was Boudica, the Icenian queen of Camulodunum. In AD 60 Boudica's husband Prasutagus died, leaving a will that gave half his kingdom to Rome and half to his two daughters; the Roman procurator instead confiscated the whole estate before the heirs came of age, and a general revolt followed among a whole list of the eastern tribes. In the same campaigning season Paulinus struck across the strait at the island, and the effect was to draw off the forces the empire needed in the east, where the rising broke out immediately afterwards. Paulinus was afterwards recalled to Rome and, according to Tacitus, was granted the honour of a triumph; the eastern war was settled by his successor Petronius Turpilianus in AD 61 to 62, while the island itself was not recovered until AD 78, when Agricola took it again.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬弩砲是帝國軍隊野戰序列中的直射火器：以木構機身、鐵軸與絞盤為骨，用搓緊的牛筋與馬鬃束儲存勢能，經臂板與導槽把一支鐵鏃弩矢射出，一發一矢，射程可達數百米，兩到三人即可操作。它的戰術位置很清楚：不是用來打穿城牆，那是石砲與撞錘的活；它的本分是平射遠處密集的人陣，並在進攻縱隊接近時提供掩護。安格爾西這場戰役裡，古老的文獻並沒有點名弩砲。狄奧只寫保利努斯備妥艦隊、把善於泅水的巴達維人與吞格利人藏進林中，渡海後驅散守軍；這是一場奇襲而不是攻城，因此沒有留下砲擊城牆的記錄。但弩砲在這個時期的不列顛戰場上確實大量使用，證據就在安格爾西對岸的威爾斯：北威爾斯克里伊迪山脈的米尼德里丘古堡在考古發掘中出土數以千計的羅馬弩砲鐵鏃，考古報告的數量逾三千枚，被認為是一次持續轟擊留下的，年代落在公元50至60年代，正是保利努斯在北威爾斯用兵的時段；利安半島的迪納斯丁利古堡同樣出土弩砲鐵鏃，該堡壘的多重土壘正是在羅馬進攻中被射擊破壞。與弩砲並列的是當時羅馬軍隊的標準配備：步兵的矩形大盾、重標槍、短劍、鎖子甲與青銅頭盔，輔助軍的標槍手、弓箭手與投石索手，以及攻城用的撞錘、繩橋與可移動攻城塔；海軍一側是裝有喙板的戰艦與載送戰團的運輸船。真正決定本役成敗的裝備不是任何一件火器，而是渡海器材與就地砍下的木料：讓步兵在退潮時涉過海峽淺灘的經驗，加上能迅速搭起登岸器材的森林。
kitsEn: The card face shows the Roman torsion bolt-thrower as it stood in the field order of the imperial army: a timber frame with iron axles and a windlass, storing its potential in bundles of twisted sinew and horsehair, and passing it through the arm and the channel to fling a single iron-headed bolt, one bolt to a shot, with a range of several hundred metres and a crew of two or three men. Its tactical place is clear. It was not the machine that broke walls: that was the work of the stone-thrower and the ram. The bolt-thrower's office was to shoot flat into a massed body of men at a distance and to give cover while a column of attack closed. In the Angles campaign the ancient sources do not name the bolt-thrower at all. Dio writes only that Paulinus provided a fleet and hid the Batavians and the Tungrians, who were skilled in swimming, in the woods, and that they crossed and drove off the defenders. This was a surprise, not a siege, and no firing at walls is recorded. The bolt-thrower was nevertheless used heavily on British battlefields of this period, and the evidence lies just across the strait from Anglesey, in Wales. At the hillfort of Mynydd Rhiw in the Clwydian range in north Wales the excavation produced a large assemblage of Roman bolt-heads, reported at more than three thousand, interpreted as the debris of a sustained bombardment and dated to the 50s and 60s AD, exactly the years in which Paulinus was campaigning in north Wales; the fort of Dinas Dinlle on the Llŷn peninsula likewise yielded a bolt-head, and its multiple ramparts show the damage of Roman shooting. Alongside the bolt-thrower stood the rest of the standard Roman load: the rectangular scutum, the heavy pilum, the short gladius, mail armour and the bronze helmet of the infantry; the javelin-men, archers and slingers of the auxiliaries; and for siege work the ram, the rope bridge and the movable tower. On the naval side there were the warships with their corvus boarding bridges and the transports that carried the legions. What in fact decided the campaign was no firepower at all but the means of crossing and the timber cut on the spot: the experience of wading the shallows of the strait at low water, and the woods from which landing gear could be built in a hurry.
tactics: 這場戰役的戰術核心是欺敵渡海，做法在古代作家筆下相當清楚。狄奧記載，保利努斯先為進攻備妥一支艦隊，讓戰艦在海峽裡展示旗幟，把島民的注意力完全吸到海面這一側；同時，最善戰的步兵——巴達維人與吞格利人這兩個以泅水著稱的輔助軍團，連同精銳的戰團兵——隱藏在海峽對岸的樹林裡。守軍不是沒有準備：他們看到羅馬艦隊，判斷正面會有一場海戰，於是把削尖的木樁打入海床的淺水處，企圖讓任何登岸的人馬被刺穿，同時把自有的船隻藏進海灣，準備在海上接戰。羅馬人等的正是這個反應。當守軍的注意力全落在海上的帆影時，步兵在退潮的淺灘上涉水而過，巴達維人與吞格利人游在前排，盾牌舉過頭頂以護住頭面與弩箭，上岸後立刻奪下灘頭，再以密集盾牆向島內推進，把聚在聚落與聖地周圍的守軍驅散，追擊到島的內陸，燒掉了聚落與德魯伊的聖林。整個過程有兩個關鍵：一是把進攻方向與實際進攻方向分開，讓對手自己把兵力擺到錯的一邊；二是完全不放棄速度，木樁柵被越過之後，餘下的時間全部用在前衝而不是圍攻上。也正因如此，羅馬人奪島之後沒有留下駐紮編制，能帶走的帶走，其餘撤回本土。這一課在十八年後被重複了一遍——塔西佗《阿格里科拉傳》第二十四節記載，阿格里科拉派出的艦隊剛一出現，島上的布里吞人便以為大軍壓境，紛紛逃往本土，羅馬軍隨即渡海追擊，島嶼再度落入帝國控制，並在本土的塞貢提烏姆建起永久據點。島民在起義中再度反叛，說明六十年代那場勝利在政治上並不牢靠。
tacticsEn: The tactical core of this campaign was a crossing made by deception, and the procedure is set out clearly in the ancient writers. Dio records that Paulinus first provided a fleet for the attack, letting the warships show their banners in the strait and drawing the islanders' attention entirely to the seaward side; at the same time the best troops, the Batavians and the Tungrians, those auxiliary cohorts famous for swimming, together with picked legionary infantry, were hidden in the woods on the mainland shore. The defenders were not unprepared. Seeing the Roman fleet they judged that a naval engagement was coming, and they drove sharpened stakes into the shallows of the sea-bed to impale anyone who tried to land, while hiding their own boats in the coves ready to meet the Romans at sea. What the Romans were waiting for was exactly that reaction. While the defenders' attention was fixed on the sails, the infantry waded across the shallows at low water, the Batavians and the Tungrians swimming in front with their shields held above their heads to protect face and head from missiles; on landing they seized the beach at once, advanced inland in a dense shield wall, drove off the defenders gathered around the settlement and the sacred place, pursued them into the interior of the island and burned the settlement and the Druidic groves. Two things decide the operation. The first is that the direction of attack and the real direction of attack are separated, so that the enemy places its own strength on the wrong side. The second is that speed is never relaxed: once the line of stakes had been crossed, all the remaining time went into the charge rather than into a blockade. That is also why no garrison was left behind. Whatever could be carried away was carried away and the rest withdrew to the mainland. The lesson was repeated eighteen years later: Tacitus reports in the twenty-fourth chapter of the Agricola that when Agricola's fleet appeared, the Britons of the island, believing a great host was coming, fled to the mainland; the Romans followed across and retook the island, and established a permanent base on the mainland at Segontium. The island's renewed participation in the rising shows that the victory of the sixties was politically fragile.
data: 可以核對的數字不多，逐一列出並標明出處。年份：六十年代，保利努斯進攻曼島一般定於公元60年；此後伊肯尼人的起義通常定於公元60至61年，掃平則在公元61至62年，島嶼在公元78年被阿格里科拉重新收復。月份：文獻只寫季節不寫月，卡面標的月份是按羅馬在布列塔尼亞春季開拔的慣例推定。地理：曼島長約七十六公里、寬約四十公里，面積約七百五十平方公里；梅奈海峽最窄處約一點二公里，退潮時有大片淺灘可行人，這正是渡海得以成功的前提；島與本土之間的渡口在梅奈橋與博馬里斯一線。艦隊：文獻只說備妥艦隊，不載船數；帝國海軍在英吉利海峽的分遣隊以三列槳船與五列槳船為主，輔以載兵的快速船。兵力：攻島的突擊部隊人數沒有記載，按帝國軍制推估，兩個輔助軍團加一個戰團分遣隊約在數千之數；狄奧記載東線起義時伊肯尼人及其他部族的兵力約七萬，這是古代作家誇張的寫法，不宜當作統計；同樣，狄奧所記羅馬與盟軍陣亡逾十萬之數亦屬修辭性表述。可核的戰損只有一件事：從西線馳援的一支縱隊約二千人，全軍覆沒，其中含戰團的分遣隊與若干輔助軍。考古數據：北威爾斯米尼德里丘古堡出土的羅馬弩砲鐵鏃，考古報告的數量逾三千枚；利安半島迪納斯丁利古堡亦出土弩砲鐵鏃與被砲擊破壞的土壘。時間跨度：從奪島到島嶼再度易手，約十八年。
dataEn: Few numbers can be checked, and they are best given one by one with their source. Dates: in the sixties the attack by Paulinus on Mona is generally dated to AD 60; the Icenian rising that followed is usually dated to AD 60 or 61, its pacification to AD 61 or 62, and the recovery of the island by Agricola to AD 78. Month: the sources give the season and not the month, so the month on the card is a conventional reconstruction from the habit of Roman campaigning in Britain in spring. Geography: Mona is about seventy-six kilometres long and forty wide, with an area of roughly seven hundred and fifty square kilometres; the Menai Strait narrows to about one point two kilometres, and at low water broad flats are walkable, which is precisely what made the crossing possible; the ferry line between the island and the mainland runs at Menai Bridge and Beaumaris. Fleet: the sources say only that a fleet was provided and give no number of ships; the imperial naval detachment in the English Channel was built on triremes and quinqueremes, with fast transports for the troops. Numbers of men: no figure survives for the assault force; by the Roman establishment, two auxiliary cohorts and a legionary detachment would amount to some thousands. Dio gives about seventy thousand for the Iceni and the other tribes in the eastern rising, which is the exaggerated figure of an ancient writer and should not be treated as a statistic; in the same way, Dio's statement that upwards of a hundred thousand Romans and allies were lost is rhetorical. One loss can be checked: a relief column of about two thousand men from the western side was destroyed entire, including a legionary detachment and a number of auxiliaries. Archaeological data: the excavation of the hillfort of Mynydd Rhiw in north Wales produced Roman bolt-heads reported at more than three thousand in number, and the fort of Dinas Dinlle on the Llŷn peninsula likewise yielded bolt-heads together with rampart damage from bombardment. Span of time: about eighteen years separate the taking of the island from its changing hands again.
cause: 羅馬為什麼要打一座島？答案有三層。最直接的一層是德魯伊。公元43年克勞狄在布列塔尼亞展開征服時，羅馬系統性地清剿德魯伊的祭司團體，德魯伊的勢力退回海峽中的曼島；那裡有天然屏障隔絕支援，有不為羅馬所動的聖地與成片的聖林，成為島民信仰中心與反羅馬情緒的匯集處。對羅馬而言，一個能號召北線部族的祭祀中心，其危害不比一位國王小。戰略層面更實際：英格蘭大部並未真正征服，羅馬在北威爾斯的前進線一直延伸到海峽，而海峽是通往愛爾蘭海與更北喀里多尼亞的跳板；控制曼島就等於控制了不列顛行省西部的海路與未來的北上基地，帝國在北方剩下的選項因此大增。政治層面則是常規的帝國邏輯：客戶王體制只能穩住那些願意接受羅馬仲裁的王國，卻無法約束不承認任何中心的島上社群；公元43年卡拉塔庫斯的使團正說明這套體制的軟肋——羅馬給予承認與保護，但也藉此否認了客戶王之外的任何權威，於是北線上每一個不肯接受羅馬仲裁的群體都成了潛在的敵人。還有一層是聯盟的牽制：卡姆羅迪努姆的伊肯尼王國與卡特維拉尼人的王國表面臣服，東線的部族一直在觀望羅馬的處境；德魯伊在島上的存在，恰恰讓東線與北線的反抗有了共同的理由。於是羅馬把攻擊的時機選在東線尚未失控之前，而這個判斷本身，既是這場戰役能迅速取勝的原因，也是它日後功虧一簣的原因。
causeEn: Why did Rome attack an island? There are three layers of reason. The most immediate is the Druids. When Claudius opened the conquest of Britannia in AD 43, Rome systematically broke up the Druidic priesthood, and the Druidic power withdrew to Mona in the strait; there the natural barriers cut off help from outside, and there stood the sacred places and the groves that would not be moved by Rome, making the island the meeting point of the islanders' religious life and their resentment. To Rome a sanctuary that could call the northern tribes was no less dangerous than a king. The strategic layer is more practical. Most of England was not conquered in any real sense, the Roman line in north Wales ran out to the strait, and the strait was the stepping stone to the Irish Sea and to Caledonia further north; holding Mona meant holding the western sea lane of the province of Britannia and its future base for the northward advance, and the empire's options in the north grew accordingly. The political layer is the ordinary logic of empire. The system of client kings could hold only those rulers willing to accept Roman arbitration, and could not bind island communities that acknowledged no centre at all; the embassy of Caratacus in AD 43 shows exactly where that system was weak, for Rome gave recognition and protection while denying every authority other than the client's, so that every northern group unwilling to submit to Roman arbitration was a potential enemy. There was also the pull of alliance. The Icenian kingdom of Camulodunum and the Catuvellaunian kings were subjects on paper, and the eastern tribes were watching how Rome fared; the presence of the Druids on the island gave the eastern and northern resistances a common cause. Rome therefore chose the moment before the east had slipped out of hand, and that judgement was both the reason the campaign went so quickly and the reason it was later thrown away.
impact: 這場戰役的直接影響落在德魯伊身上。島上的聖地、聚落與聖林被燒毀，德魯伊作為北線抵抗象徵的地位遭到摧毀，後世的編年史與傳記作品也把島上德魯伊巢穴的清剿記為這次行動的主要成果。對羅馬的征服工程而言，這是一個象徵性的里程碑：第一次以登陸作戰的方式深入不列顛西部的海峽，把北威爾斯的山地戰線與海峽控制權連成一體，帝國在英國的版圖第一次實際跨過水面。但政治上的成果極為脆弱。卡姆羅迪努姆的起義在同一個戰役季節爆發，東線的羅馬援軍被消耗殆盡，島上的守軍趁亂重新站回島嶼，羅馬用了三年才在東線恢復元氣，同時失去了英國西部唯一一座可以監視海峽的據點。真正的重新征服要等到公元78年阿格里科拉，他把同一套艦隊佯動、步兵渡海的戰法再演一次，在本土的塞貢提烏姆建立永久基地，島上從此常駐帝國的行政與軍事的影子，港口與渡口的航線也收歸帝國稅制管轄。歷史上的安格爾西之名也由此而來：後來南遷的盎格魯人聚居在島上，島名成為他們的屬地代稱，幾個世紀後又被挪用到威爾斯北岸的一個郡。技術上，這場戰役與隨後北威爾斯山堡的圍攻一同，標誌著弩砲一類野戰火器在第一世紀的不列顛進入常規使用：在石彈尚未普遍裝備之前，鐵鏃弩矢以每分鐘一發的射速驅散城頭與斜坡上的人，是羅馬在島嶼與山地方圓得手的主要手段，也是卡面這件兵器在北線最有實戰意義的落點。
impactEn: The immediate effect of the campaign fell on the Druids. The sacred places, the settlement and the groves on the island were burned, and the Druids' standing as a symbol of northern resistance was destroyed; the later chronicles and biographies alike record the clearing out of the Druidic nest on the island as the chief result of the operation. For the Roman conquest it was a symbolic milestone: the first landing operation carried deep into the western straits of Britain, tying the mountainous front in north Wales together with control of the strait, and the empire's map of Britain for the first time actually crossed water. Politically, though, the result was extremely fragile. The rising at Camulodunum broke out in the same campaigning season, the Roman relief force in the east was consumed, and the island's defenders reoccupied the island while Rome was in disarray; it took three years for Rome to recover in the east, and it lost at the same time the only post on the western seaboard from which the strait could be watched. The real reconquest came in AD 78 with Agricola, who played the trick of the fleet and the wading infantry a second time, founded the permanent base at Segontium on the mainland, and from then on the island carried the shadow of Roman administration and garrison, while the shipping of its harbours and crossing points passed under the Roman tax system. The modern name Anglesey also descends from this: the Anglii who later settled on the island gave the island their name as a territorial designation, and centuries afterwards that name was carried over to a county on the north Wales coast. On the technical side, this campaign and the sieges of the north Welsh hillforts that followed mark the moment when field artillery of the bolt-thrower type entered regular service in first-century Britain: before stone shot became general, an iron-tipped bolt fired at something like one round a minute was what broke up the men on the ramparts and the slopes, and it was the chief means by which Rome took island and upland positions alike. That is the point at which the weapon on the card had its most practical work to do on the northern front.
result: 公元60年，波利努斯的突擊成功：守軍被逐出曼島，島上聚落焚毀，德魯伊的據點被清剿，羅馬海軍短時間內控制了梅奈海峽。就戰役本身而言，這是一次乾淨利落、幾乎沒有付出重大代價的勝利：它靠的是欺騙、速度與泅渡，而不是攻城器械的長時間消耗，這也正是文獻裡找不到任何攻城砲在島上開火記錄的原因。但作為一場征服，它的結論是開放的。羅馬沒有在島上設防、沒有留下守軍、沒有建立行省或稅務機構，征服的成果只維持到東線起義爆發為止；伊肯尼人的起義蔓延到島上，保利努斯被迫放棄攻勢、乘船撤回本土，島嶼重新落入布里吞人之手，直到公元78年才由阿格里科拉以更大的兵力與更完整的據點體系再度收復。因此對這個年代的史家而言，公元60年的曼島之役更像是公元78年征服的前奏，而不是完成品：它證明了帝國軍隊能跨越海峽、能在沒有工事的島上打贏，也同時證明了沒有駐紮的勝利只等於一次襲擊，攻下土地與佔有土地在帝國的邊疆政策裡是兩件事。這條教訓在接下來的北進中被反覆記住——阿格里科拉在島上留下的不是榮耀，而是本土那座塞貢提烏姆堡壘，以及由它控制的一整條海峽航線；曼島上的德魯伊巢穴雖然毀了，島的形勢要等到更往後才真正穩定下來。
resultEn: In AD 60 Paulinus's assault succeeded: the defenders were driven off Mona, the settlement was burned, the Druidic stronghold was cleared out, and for a time the Roman navy held the Menai Strait. As a battle the campaign was clean and cost little: it turned on deception, speed and wading rather than on a long consumption of siege engines, which is precisely why the sources record no siege gun firing on the island. As a conquest, however, its outcome was left open. Rome built no fort, left no garrison, established no province and no tax office, and the result lasted only until the rising in the east broke out; the Icenian revolt reached the island, Paulinus had to give up the offensive and withdraw to the mainland by sea, and the island passed back into the hands of the Britons until Agricola recovered it in AD 78 with a larger force and a complete system of bases. For historians of the period, therefore, the Mona campaign of AD 60 is better read as a prelude to the conquest of AD 78 than as the finished thing: it proved that the imperial army could cross a strait and could win on an island with no walls, and it proved just as plainly that a victory without a garrison amounts to no more than a raid. Taking ground and holding ground are two different things in the empire's frontier policy. The lesson was repeated in the northward advance that followed: what Agricola left on the island was not glory but the fort of Segontium on the mainland and the whole chain of sea lanes it commanded; the Druidic nest on Mona was destroyed, but the position of the island was not settled until a good deal later.
